label: Cline CLI Access
description: A Cline login, for the ClineCli nodes' `access`: a key for Cline's own provider, or a provider of your own and its key. One access for however many ClineCli nodes. A sign-in (Cline's account, a ChatGPT subscription) and providers that run on another tool's login on your machine (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) are not offered: leave `access` out on your machine for those.

steps: In your Cline account, create an API key.
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that account.
Name the provider by Cline's id for it (`anthropic`, `openrouter`, ...), as `cline auth -p <provider>` takes it.
Paste that provider's API key below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that provider's account.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the ClineCli nodes' `access` input.
